name: Backdrop
description: A picture behind the whole window. Replace backdrop.webp with your own image.

settings.title: Fade
settings.description: How much of the theme's background covers the picture. Higher keeps text easier to read.

settings.title: Behind the sidebar
settings.description: Show the picture behind the sidebar too, not only behind the chat.

settings.title: Keep in view
settings.description: Which part of the picture stays visible when the window is a different shape.
